answer: Give every identity a reputation that only grows through weeks of verified useful work and decays with idleness: a new face starts at zero trust, like a seedling in a grove, and earns paid tasks only after a long season of honest contributions. A comet that flashes past once leaves nothing behind, while a pearl forms slowly, layer on layer, and so does trust. A sybil operator must nurse a thousand seedlings through a thousand slow seasons before any of them can earn, so forgery costs months of real work per fake face instead of one cheap registration.
